evidence_contract.note: Template is pending input, never approval. All reference paths resolve against framework, except candidate_path against candidate repository. Explicit ../ references may bind external local files. Do not migrate bindings automatically.
evidence_contract.collection_report_extra: configured: binding {path,sha256} to existing reporting binding; queued: batch_id; delivered: same batch_id and receiver receipt_id; consumed: same batch_id/receipt_id and consumer
evidence_contract.publication_report_extra: remote and receipt_id; required only for stage=published; existing common candidate/input binding still required
evidence_contract.source_delivery: Use delivery_kind=source, at least one source artifact, and validation.source report; omit runtime validations only when runtime is outside agreed scope.
evidence_contract.boundary: Hash and metadata checks do not authenticate a receipt, run tests, verify a service, authorize activation, or create another ledger. Reference existing reporting evidence; host must establish authenticity. Dependencies pin observed file bytes; declared version labels alone are not authenticated. Runnable provenance is a supplied build report, not a reproducible build performed by this checker.
